root_cause.text: The `fcloop_t2h_xmt_ls_rsp` function unconditionally invokes the `lsrsp->done` callback when `targetport` is NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when `remoteport->port_state` is not `FC_OBJSTATE_ONLINE` because the callback is only initialized when the port is online.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `drivers/nvme/target/fcloop.c` replaces the unconditional call to `lsrsp->done(lsrsp)` with a check `if (remoteport->port_state == FC_OBJSTATE_ONLINE) lsrsp->done(lsrsp); else ret = -ENODEV;`, and the commit message explains that `lsrsp->done` is only set when the port state is `FC_OBJSTATE_ONLINE`.
